SELECT 
    AVG(CASE WHEN segment = 'SME' THEN annual_consumption END) - AVG(CASE WHEN segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_consumption END) AS SME_LAM_diff,
    AVG(CASE WHEN segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_consumption END) - AVG(CASE WHEN segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_consumption END) AS LAM_KAM_diff,
    AVG(CASE WHEN segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_consumption END) - AVG(CASE WHEN segment = 'SME' THEN annual_consumption END) AS KAM_SME_diff
FROM (
    SELECT 
        c.segment,
        SUM(y.consumption) AS total_consumption,
        COUNT(DISTINCT y.customerid) AS customer_count,
        SUM(y.consumption) / COUNT(DISTINCT y.customerid) AS annual_consumption
    FROM 
        yearmonth y
    JOIN 
        customers c ON y.customerid = c.customerid
    WHERE 
        y.date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' AND c.currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY 
        c.segment
) AS segment_consumption
WHERE 
    total_consumption = (SELECT MIN(total_consumption) 
                         FROM (
                             SELECT 
                                 SUM(y.consumption) AS total_consumption
                             FROM 
                                 yearmonth y
                             JOIN 
                                 customers c ON y.customerid = c.customerid
                             WHERE 
                                 y.date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' AND c.currency = 'CZK'
                             GROUP BY 
                                 c.segment, y.customerid
                         ) AS subquery
                         GROUP BY segment)	----- bird -----	debit_card_specializing
